title: User Interface Integration
summary: This module provides adapters and endpoints for integrating Pydantic AI agents with various user interfaces, handling the transformation of UI requests into agent inputs and agent outputs into UI-specific streaming events. It supports protocols like AG-UI and Vercel AI SDK.

nodes.label: Receive HTTP Request
nodes.title: Incoming HTTP Request
nodes.description: Represents an incoming HTTP request from a client, typically a web browser or a Vercel AI frontend, initiating an interaction.

nodes.label: Send HTTP Response
nodes.title: Outgoing HTTP Response
nodes.description: Represents an outgoing HTTP response sent back to the client, often containing streamed events or configuration data.

nodes.label: Agent Core Logic
nodes.title: Pydantic AI Agent Execution
nodes.description: The core Pydantic AI agent responsible for processing prompts, managing conversation state, and executing tools based on its configuration.

nodes.label: Capabilities & Tools
nodes.title: Agent Capabilities & Tools
nodes.description: External capabilities and toolsets that the agent can utilize during its execution, providing extended functionality.

nodes.label: Run AG-UI Agent
nodes.title: run_ag_ui
nodes.description: The primary function to initiate an agent run specifically for the AG-UI frontend, handling input and streaming output events according to the AG-UI protocol.

nodes.label: Base UI Adapter
nodes.title: UIAdapter
nodes.description: An abstract base class providing common logic for adapting UI requests into agent inputs and transforming agent outputs into UI-specific events for various frontends.

nodes.label: UI Event Stream Transformer
nodes.title: UIEventStream
nodes.description: A component responsible for transforming internal Pydantic AI events into a specific UI protocol's event format, managing event flow and encoding for streaming.

nodes.label: AG-UI Frontend Toolset
nodes.title: _AGUIFrontendToolset
nodes.description: Integrates tools defined by the AG-UI frontend, converting them into a format usable by the agent's tool ecosystem for execution.

nodes.label: Vercel AI Adapter
nodes.title: VercelAIAdapter
nodes.description: A concrete implementation of the UI adapter for integrating with the Vercel AI SDK protocol, handling message conversion, tool approval, and event streaming.

nodes.label: Configure Frontend
nodes.title: configure_frontend
nodes.description: An API endpoint that dynamically provides the UI frontend with necessary configuration, such as available models and integrated tools.

nodes.label: Handle Vercel AI Chat
nodes.title: post_chat
nodes.description: An API endpoint that receives chat requests from the Vercel AI frontend, orchestrates agent execution, and streams back protocol-specific responses.

nodes.label: Vercel AI Request Data
nodes.title: Vercel AI Incoming Data Structures
nodes.description: Pydantic models defining the structured data for incoming requests from the Vercel AI frontend, including user messages, tool inputs, and approval responses.

nodes.label: Vercel AI Response Data
nodes.title: Vercel AI Outgoing Data Structures
nodes.description: Pydantic models defining the structured streaming chunks and message metadata for responses sent to the Vercel AI frontend, such as text, sources, and tool states.

groups.label: User-Facing Endpoints
groups.title: User-Facing Endpoints
groups.description: These components serve as the direct entry points for user interactions with the AI system through various UIs.

groups.label: UI Adapter Core
groups.title: UI Adapter Core
groups.description: Core components responsible for abstracting UI interactions, handling request/response transformations, and managing event streaming.

groups.label: AG-UI Integration
groups.title: AG-UI Integration
groups.description: Components specifically designed for integrating Pydantic AI agents with the AG-UI frontend protocol.

groups.label: Vercel AI Integration
groups.title: Vercel AI Integration
groups.description: Components and data structures dedicated to integrating Pydantic AI agents with the Vercel AI SDK protocol.
